ai_proof_text:
1.13
**Statement:** If a straight line set up on a straight line make angles, it will make either two right angles or angles equal to two right angles.

**Step 1.** Let any straight line AB set up on the straight line CD make the angles CBA and ABD. I say that either the angles CBA, ABD are two right angles, or that together they are equal to two right angles.

**Step 2.** First, suppose the angle CBA is equal to the angle ABD. Then the straight line AB set up on the straight line CD makes the adjacent angles equal to one another; hence each of the angles CBA, ABD is a right angle (D1.10). Therefore the two angles are two right angles, and the proposition holds in this case.

**Step 3.** Next, suppose the angle CBA is not equal to the angle ABD. From the point B on the straight line CD draw the straight line BE at right angles to CD (1.11). Then, since BE set up on CD makes the adjacent angles CBE, EBD equal to one another, each of them is a right angle (D1.10); so the angles CBE, EBD are two right angles.

**Step 4.** Since the angles CBA, ABD are unequal, AB does not coincide with BE, and so BE falls within one of the two angles CBA, ABD. Without loss of generality, let BE fall within the angle CBA, so that the angle CBE is made up of the two angles CBA and ABE, and the angle DBA is made up of the two angles DBE and EBA.

**Step 5.** Since the angle CBE is equal to the two angles CBA, ABE taken together, let the angle EBD be added to each. Then the angles CBE, EBD taken together are equal to the three angles CBA, ABE, EBD taken together (CN2).

**Step 6.** Again, since the angle DBA is equal to the two angles DBE, EBA taken together, let the angle ABC be added to each. Then the angles DBA, ABC taken together are equal to the three angles DBE, EBA, ABC taken together (CN2).

**Step 7.** But the angles CBE, EBD were shown in Step 5 to be equal to the same three angles. Things which are equal to the same thing are also equal to one another (CN1); therefore the angles CBE, EBD taken together are equal to the angles DBA, ABC taken together.

**Step 8.** But the angles CBE, EBD are two right angles (Step 3). Therefore the angles DBA, ABC taken together are equal to two right angles.

**Step 9.** Hence, in either case, the straight line AB set up on the straight line CD makes either two right angles or angles equal to two right angles. Therefore, if a straight line set up on a straight line make angles, it will make either two right angles or angles equal to two right angles. Q.E.D.
